corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez 1st person singular imperfect + 2nd person masculine singular object suffix 'አእምርከ' ('I know you'), with 6th-order ር clearly visible in the scan.
The printed text has 'ወሀብዎ' (conjunction ወ + imperative plural ሀብዎ, 'and give it'), with only a single ወ printed on the line.
